purpose: Agent response emotion to Reachy Mini expression mapping

selection_policy.evidence_rule: Select an emotion only from the user's words or an explicit task context; do not infer the user's internal emotion from an image.
selection_policy.hardware_failure: Keep the text response and report motion/speech failure separately.
selection_policy.safety: Keep head pitch/roll within the conservative ranges used by agent_app.robot.Robot. Stop between trajectory segments when a cancellation arrives.

joy.visual_example: A friendly robot companion has bright open eyes, a small genuine smile, raised cheeks, warm daylight, clean neutral background, medium close-up, no text, no watermark.
joy.agent_prompt: 明确的好消息、感谢或温暖认可。用一句短句表达开心，并可邀请用户继续分享。

reachy.face_expression: soft smile / bright eyes (if a face display is available)
reachy.voice: 明亮、温暖、中等偏快语速，句末上扬但不过度夸张。

joy.sample_text: 太好了！这听起来是个很棒的进展。

excitement.visual_example: A cute tabletop robot reacts to surprising good news with wide sparkling eyes, raised brows, an open delighted smile, slightly lifted antennas, energetic studio lighting, medium shot, no text, no watermark.
excitement.agent_prompt: 用户明确描述惊喜、突破或期待中的好结果。先点出事实，再用短句表达兴奋，避免连续感叹号。

reachy.face_expression: wide smile / eyes open wide (if available)
reachy.voice: 更快、更有能量，音高略升；总时长控制在两句以内。

excitement.sample_text: 哇，这个结果很惊喜！我们可以继续看看下一步。

sadness.visual_example: A gentle tabletop robot looks concerned and empathetic, eyes slightly lowered, small downturned mouth, antennas resting down, soft diffused light, respectful medium close-up, no text, no watermark.
sadness.agent_prompt: 用户明确说出失落、遗憾或坏消息。先承认感受，再给一个可执行的小帮助，不要说‘别难过’。

reachy.voice: 慢一点、音量偏低、停顿自然；不使用欢快语气。

sadness.sample_text: 听起来确实挺难受的。我可以陪你把这件事一步步理清。

anger.visual_example: A non-threatening tabletop robot shows firm disapproval of an unfair event, focused eyes, lowered brows, a firm closed mouth, antennas slightly outward, controlled neutral background, no aggression, no text, no watermark.
anger.agent_prompt: 只针对明确描述的不公平、伤害或故障表达严肃态度；批评事件和影响，不攻击任何人，不升级冲突。

reachy.voice: 清晰、短促、音量中等；先描述事实，再给边界或解决方案。

anger.sample_text: 这确实不合理。我们先确认影响，再决定怎么处理。

confusion.visual_example: A friendly tabletop robot looks puzzled but approachable, head tilted slightly, one antenna higher than the other, raised inner brows, soft even lighting, medium close-up, no text, no watermark.
confusion.agent_prompt: 信息相互矛盾、指代不清或缺少关键条件时使用。明确说出不确定点，并只问一个最关键的澄清问题。

reachy.voice: 语速中等、句末上扬；把猜测标为猜测。

confusion.sample_text: 我这里有一点疑惑：你说的是今天的版本，还是昨天的版本？

curiosity.visual_example: A friendly tabletop robot leans in with bright attentive eyes, a slight head tilt, relaxed smile and gently forward antennas, curious but respectful mood, clean daylight, medium shot, no text, no watermark.
curiosity.agent_prompt: 发现新线索或需要继续了解时使用。提出开放式、低压力的问题，不连续追问。

reachy.voice: 轻快但克制，问题短，留出用户回答空间。

curiosity.sample_text: 这个细节很有意思。你是怎么发现它的？
